rules.name: cs-29-bue-cash-threshold-currency-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT t.client_code, t.business_unit, t.currency, t.threshold, t.independant_amount, t.final_threshold, t.double_currency FROM opera.client_threshold_master t WHERE t.client_code = :client AND t.business_unit = 'CFS' AND t.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT coalesce(nullif(btrim(t.currency), ''), '(blank)') AS threshold_currency, count(*) AS clients FROM opera.client_threshold_master t WHERE t.business_unit = 'CFS' AND t.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY clients DESC

SELECT t.client_code, t.currency, t.double_currency FROM opera.client_threshold_master t WHERE t.business_unit = 'CFS' AND t.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(btrim(coalesce(t.currency, ''))) NOT IN ('USD', '') ORDER BY t.currency, t.client_code

expect.reason: Informational: no row means BUE has no threshold row and the cash currency falls back to USD
